projects.title: PROJECTS
projects.login.title: Fancy Login Page
projects.login.desc: My first hands-on experience in web development began with designing a simple user authentication page, making the first stepping stone in my learning journey.
projects.laundry.title: WashWise
projects.laundry.desc: A Python-based project integrating APIs within a modern technological environment. This project provided hands-on experience with real-world applications and strengthened my knowledge over practical workflows.
projects.julvry.title: Julvry
projects.julvry.desc: This project was my first experience working in a team to develop a jewelry marketing website. It enhanced my collaboration and communication skills while improving my time management and commitment to self-improvement.
projects.quiz-game.title: Quiz Game
projects.quiz-game.desc: An English-Japanese sentence quiz game where players must answer as many questions correctly as possible within a limited time to achieve a high score. Scores will be displayed on a leaderboard ranked by player performance.
projects.sns.title: Space and Time
projects.sns.desc: A next-generation social media platform designed with a modern interface and equipped with a wide range of features for user convenience. The developers of this project were given the freedom to explore ideas and express their creativity while maintaining performance optimization across different devices.
projects.nlp.title: Smart Translator
projects.nlp.desc: A smart translation application that allows users to choose different translation styles, such as casual, polite, and business expressions. This project focuses not only on translation accuracy, but also on delivering local nuances, modern vocabulary, and cultural context to help bridge communication gaps.
projects.romanized-kh.title: Khmer Transliteration Keyboard
projects.romanized-kh.desc: A Romanized Khmer-to-Khmer script input system that converts Khmer words typed using Latin letters into proper Khmer script. A hybrid of rule-based and dictionary based system for candidate generation, model ranking, and manual label data. The project has successfully integrated into Window IME prototype.
projects.to-do-app.title: To-Do App
projects.to-do-app.desc: A task management app that helps users efficiently track task progress, accompanied by a calendar feature. The design is inspired by a comic style, the app makes completed tasks light up with green checkmarks, creating a satisfying sense of progress and motivating users to finish more — bringing to-do lists to life.
